design_principles: WTC shared stimulus with four part-level evidence jobs

destination_notes.Practice: Exactly 24 per section: 8 Intro, 8 Review, 8 Mastery.
destination_notes.Exit Ticket: Four per section with rolling Q1-Q2 carryforward and fresh Q3-Q4 parallels.
destination_notes.Summative: Six secure forms, eight items per form, two evidence opportunities per Unit 1 Mastery Goal.
destination_notes.WTC: One shared-stimulus A-D set per section.
destination_notes.Seeds: Six approved reusable Unit 1 seed families.

planned_slots.title: Relationship in Four Views
planned_slots.evidence_job: Parameterize a single relationship across table, graph, rule, and context; ask students to translate or reconcile views.

planned_slots.title: Graph Scale + Intercept
planned_slots.evidence_job: Generate a readable coordinate graph with nontrivial scale or intercept evidence and ask for a value plus interpretation.

planned_slots.title: Function Mapping Misconception
planned_slots.evidence_job: Build a table, mapping, or ordered-pair set with a purposeful repeated-input misconception and require a function decision with evidence.

planned_slots.title: Function-Family Growth Comparison
planned_slots.evidence_job: Generate two or more growth patterns that invite family recognition and comparison using table or graph evidence.

planned_slots.title: Expression Error Patterns
planned_slots.evidence_job: Generate a plausible combine-like-terms, distribution, substitution, or order-of-operations error for critique and repair.

planned_slots.title: Equation-Model Context
planned_slots.evidence_job: Generate a short context with a meaningful variable, equation, solution, and interpretation/check path.
